context: ADR in docs/development/adr/ citing and superseding mcp-product-surface-and-shared-run-service-decision. Keep its two durable preserves (schema-derived docs tests; no benchbox.cli imports from MCP). Retire only the 'smoke/control-plane' product-tier designation and the 'MCP must not imply CLI option parity' clause; replace with the three-tier ledger semantics. Do not change any runtime behavior in this item -- docs, ADR, and contract tests only.
description: Governance gate for the one-engine program. The 2026-05-21 decision (mcp-product-surface-and-shared-run-service-decision) designated MCP a 'beta-public smoke/control-plane surface, not a CLI-equivalent execution surface'. That premise has been overtaken: MCP gained remote HTTP transport (#1447), auth (#1454), durable tenant jobs (#1458/#1459), readiness gates (#1460/#1461), and a platform-option contract matrix (#1490). Write a superseding ADR establishing 'one engine, scoped surfaces': ALL business logic lives in benchbox.core below both surfaces; surface asymmetry is deliberate and ledgered with exactly three ratified tier reasons per omission: security-scoped (credentials, publish, arbitrary paths -- never on remote MCP), interaction-scoped (wizards/shell/REPLs CLI-only; jobs/admission MCP-only), or not-yet-demanded (promotable without a new decision once the shared run service exists). Reclassify the 23-flag OMITTED_CLI_OPTIONS ledger (tests/unit/mcp/test_run_surface_contract.py:72-96, docs/reference/mcp.md:303-315) into those tiers. Update docs/reference/mcp.md and docs/reference/public-contracts.md row 42, and rewrite the pinned contract strings asserted by tests/unit/mcp/test_run_surface_contract.py:208 in the same change (the test asserts the current anti-parity wording verbatim, so docs and test move together).

anti_patterns.dont: change runtime code in this item
anti_patterns.instead: docs + ADR + contract-test strings only; runtime unification lands in the downstream one-engine items
anti_patterns.why: governance must land reviewable and revertible on its own

anti_patterns.dont: delete the 23-flag ledger because parity is now the goal
anti_patterns.instead: retag each entry with one of the three tier reasons
anti_patterns.why: ledgered drift is the mechanism that prevents silent drift

anti_patterns.dont: loosen or bypass MCP security allowlists as part of the new contract wording
anti_patterns.instead: classify those omissions as security-scoped and keep them permanent
anti_patterns.why: the narrow surface is what makes remote/tenant mode safe; parity never applies to credential/destination controls

preserves.behavior: MCP security allowlist semantics (MCP_PLATFORM_OPTION_ALLOWLIST, admission, tenancy) are untouched by this ADR.
Schema-derived docs tests remain: MCP docs param tables must keep matching live tool schemas.
The import boundary remains: benchbox.mcp never imports benchbox.cli (AST test at test_run_surface_contract.py:272).
The omission ledger is reclassified, never deleted -- every currently omitted flag keeps an entry with a tier reason.
